data.name: Viswanathan
data.gender_notes: Viswanathan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Viswa (Universal) + Anatham (Lord). The name Viswanathan carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit, Telugu. Parents who choose Viswanathan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the supreme power of the universe and the divine presence in everything
data.etymology: Viswanathan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Viswanathan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Viswanathan is a Hindu name that originates from ancient Indian scriptures and traditions. The name "Viswanathan" is composed of two Sanskrit words - 'Viswa' (International, Cosmos, Universe) and 'Anatham' (Lord, God). This name highlights the importance of recognizing the universalGod who rules and governs the cosmos, and implies an individual's commitment towards serving and connecting with the Divine on a grand, transcendent scale.
data.spiritual_significance: For Hindus, Viswanathan is a powerful and revered name that signifies the presence and influence of the cosmic deity Vishnu who oversees the creation, preservation, and destruction of the universe. As the name suggests, Viswanathan conveys the spiritual belief that the divine being is not confined to temples or shrines, but present in and around us in every aspect of life, trying to guide, protect, and uplift the individual soul. Thus, as a Viswanathan, an individual strive to align their thoughts, words, and actions with cosmic consciousness and live a life of universal love, compassion, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Viswanathan: All-pervading wisdom or knowledge. The one who embodies universal consciousness.
